title: Senior AI Engineer

Transformer architecture, KV cache memory scaling, FlashAttention, structured schema outputs, and quantitative benchmark evaluation.

Automated prompt optimization with DSPy, MIPRO teleprompters, and LLM-as-a-judge evaluation.
Realtime WebSocket voice agents, temporal video reasoning, and OCR-free ColPali visual RAG.
